stopped_items: Item 2, first prod landing: STOPPED by me, then completed differently. 20260927020000 first carried the MV swaps and ran them under prod's default parallel settings (1 worker, 256MB). The official_sector_dollars_mv twin populated in ~1:45. The chord_industry_flows_mv twin then ran 19.5 min on CPU. Clone: 33.5 s. Prod's weekly refresh of the same MV: 236-775 s. The census failed during it: 12 renders lost / 22 events in 60 min, ratio 6.06x against floor 6; 10 of 637 requests 5xx (1.57 %) in the 09:15 bucket. I cancelled my own backend at 09:39:40 (pg_cancel_backend, pid 530684); the whole migration rolled back and the claim released. Two causes, both fixed before re-landing. (a) The function carried SET search_path, so it never inlined and the planner costed it at 1,000 rows; that yields per-donor nested loops, and ROWS 50000 does not change the plan. (b) The populate did not run refresh_derived_mvs('weekly')'s max_parallel_workers_per_gather=0 / work_mem=128MB (FIX-1109/FIX-1129). Re-landed as 020000 (functions) + 020200 (MVs), both applied (10:40, 10:44-10:51) with the census passing.
